description: List the components in an existing R3 project — what it contains and, for each one, its entityRef: the name code addresses it by (`this['mesh_cube_1']`). Read this before writing any code for a project, and after any tool call whose outcome was reported as unknown, to see what actually landed. Value components (Vector3, Color, Scalar) are not listed individually — reach them through their owner, e.g. `mesh.position.x`.

projectId.description: The project to read, from r3_project_create or the R3 app.

name: r3_project_load

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.
